texts.en:
Unstable gravitational anomalies are leaking out of the Astral Scar in [From.System.GetName], manifesting as slow-moving singularities that travel throughout nearby space before violently imploding. Ships passing through this system can avoid them, but must travel more carefully to do so.

Investigating this situation further could reveal a way to restabilize the dimensional opening.

note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

notes.zh: 触发：科研船勘察一处星界细缝时（on_survey_planet → 隐藏事件 astral_planes.6005），帝国需已掌握星界采集与裂隙探球科技、境内有星界细缝、尚未探索过“微型宇宙”、且此前未发现过这种不稳定；满足时 80% 概率开启本项目，20% 什么也不发生。
notes.en: Trigger: when a science ship surveys an Astral Scar (on_survey_planet → hidden event astral_planes.6005), if the empire has Astral Harvesting and Rift Sphere, owns a scar within its borders, has not explored the Microverse and has not found an instability before: 80% chance to open this project, 20% nothing.

texts.zh:
经过仔细分析，我们确认[From.System.GetName]中的星界细缝异常不稳定，需要立即干预以防止该恒星系进一步坍缩为引力奇点。

可以考虑将大量喷射而出的星界丝缕进行重定向、重新利用，以便“缝合”裂痕。这将修复时空的撕裂，并可能留下大量的星界物质。

或者，我们可以投射大量军火来扩大这处裂痕。我们预测，这么做将有助于我们探索伤痕另一边可能存在的事物。
texts.en:
After careful analysis, we've confirmed that the Astral Scar in [From.System.GetName] is dangerously unstable and requires immediate intervention to prevent further gravitational singularities forming in this system.

The powerful ejection of Astral Threads could be redirected and repurposed in order to 'stitch' the scar shut. This would repair the tear in space-time and likely leave behind a significant amount of astral material.

Alternatively, we could deliver a heavy payload of ordinance in an effort to widen the scar. We speculate that this would also allow for further exploration of what may be on the other side.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

texts.zh:
经过对其撕裂织构的精细操控，我们成功地完全封印了位于[From.System.GetName]的星界细缝。引力异常自那时起停止，我们在整个过程中回收了大量的星界丝缕。

无论裂缝另一边的现实如何，都不再对我们构成威胁。
texts.en:
After careful manipulation of its torn fabric, we've managed to fully seal the Astral Scar in [From.System.GetName]. Gravitational anomalies have since stopped, and we've recovered a significant quantity of Astral Threads in the process.

Whatever reality was on the other side will no longer pose a danger to our own.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

note.zh: 细缝被封闭并从星系中移除；获得大量星界丝缕与物理研究。
note.en: The scar is sealed and removed from the system; a large astral thread reward and physics research.

texts.zh:
我们投送到到[From.System.GetName]的星界细缝核心的军火扩大了时空的折叠。这里曾经只是宇宙织物中的一个小撕裂口，现在成为了一个更大的裂隙，能够让我们进入探索。

由此带来的稳定性使引力异常减弱，我们准备去发现隐藏在其中的事物。
texts.en:
The ordinance we sent into the core of the Astral Scar in [From.System.GetName] has widened the folds in space and time. Where there was once a small tear in the cosmic fabric, there is now a larger rift that we are capable of exploring.

The resulting stability has caused the gravitational anomalies to subside, and we are prepared to discover what lies beyond.

label.en: The scar opens as the Microverse rift

texts.zh:
位于[FromFromFromFrom.System.GetName]的星界细缝已经朝内坍缩了，并朝周边恒星系抛射出了大量的星界丝缕。这里的宇宙织构曾经出现过一处小小的撕裂，但如今已经是虚无的太空。

无论裂缝另一边的现实如何，都不再对我们构成威胁。
texts.en:
The Astral Scar in [FromFromFromFrom.System.GetName] has collapsed inwardly, ejecting a significant amount of Astral Threads into the nearby system. Where there was once a small tear in the cosmic fabric, there is now empty space.

Whatever reality was on the other side will no longer pose a danger to our own.

summary.text:
# 不稳定星界细缝 / Astral Scar Instability

- 分类 Category：星界裂隙 Astral rifts (C4) · DLC：星界位面 Astral Planes
- 来源 Sources：`events/astral_planes_events.txt:4005–4165`（6005–6009）；`common/special_projects/02_projects_astral_planes.txt:25–51`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1167`（on_survey_planet）
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（全篇 whole story）

## 如何开始 How it starts

科研船勘察一处星界细缝时，隐藏事件 astral_planes.6005 检查：帝国已掌握星界采集与裂隙探球科技、境内（游牧帝国除外）有星界细缝、尚未探索过“微型宇宙”裂隙、且以前没有发现过不稳定细缝。满足时 80% 概率给该星系加上不稳定修正并开启特殊项目“不稳定星界细缝”，20% 什么也不发生（`astral_planes_events.txt:4005–4052`）。项目需科研船与科学家，60 天，限时 1080 天。

When a science ship surveys an Astral Scar, hidden event astral_planes.6005 checks that the empire has Astral Harvesting and Rift Sphere, owns a scar within its borders (not required for nomads), has not explored the Microverse rift and has not found an instability before. If so, there is an 80% chance to mark the system unstable and open the special project “Astral Scar Instability”; 20% nothing happens (`astral_planes_events.txt:4005–4052`). The project needs a science ship with a scientist, takes 60 days and expires after 1080 days.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. 项目完成 → 缝补时空（6006）：细缝极不稳定，可能继续产生引力奇点。可以用喷涌的星界丝缕把它“缝死”，或投放大量弹药把它炸开、以便探索另一侧。
2. 项目超时 → 星界坍缩（6009）：细缝自行向内坍缩消失。

1. Project completed → A Stitch in Time (and Space) (6006): the scar is dangerously unstable. Stitch it shut with the escaping astral threads, or blow it open with heavy ordnance to explore the other side.
2. Project expired → Astral Collapse (6009): the scar collapses inward on its own.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 把它缝死 → 6007 宇宙之戕：细缝封闭并移除，获得大量星界丝缕与物理研究。
- 把它炸开 → 6008（标题同为“宇宙之戕”）：细缝被撕成一道可探索的裂隙——即“微型宇宙”裂隙（`split_astral_scar = { ID = microverse }`），其后的探索见“微型宇宙”篇。
- 6009 星界坍缩：细缝消失，获得少量星界丝缕。

- Stitch it shut → 6007 Cosmic Wound: the scar is sealed and removed; a large astral thread reward and physics research.
- Blow it open → 6008 (also titled “Cosmic Wound”): the scar is torn into an explorable rift — the Microverse rift (`split_astral_scar = { ID = microverse }`); its exploration continues in “The Microverse”.
- 6009 Astral Collapse: the scar disappears with a small astral thread reward.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 没有文明视角差异。注意：发现这种不稳定后，“微型宇宙”在随机裂隙池中的权重变为 0，只能通过 6008 获得。

- No empire-identity variants. Note: once this instability has been found, the Microverse's weight in the random rift pool becomes 0; it can then only be opened through 6008.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：on_survey_planet 触发、6005 的条件与 80/20 随机、项目时长与时限、6006 两个选项、6007/6008/6009 的效果，以及微型宇宙裂隙定义中的权重修正（`00_astral_rifts.txt:139–152`）。
- 修正：编译图只显示项目分支；`spawn_astral_rift`/`split_astral_scar` 的定向生成没有进入调用图，已补 6008 → “微型宇宙”裂隙的跨故事链接，并标注项目成功/超时互斥。

- Checked: the on_survey_planet trigger, the conditions and 80/20 roll of 6005, project duration and limit, both options of 6006, the effects of 6007/6008/6009, and the weight modifier in the Microverse rift definition (`00_astral_rifts.txt:139–152`).
- Correction: the compiled graph showed only the project branches; the directed spawn (`spawn_astral_rift`/`split_astral_scar`) is not in the call graph, so a cross-story link 6008 → the Microverse rift was added, and project success/expiry were marked exclusive.
